verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents its own alert rules on log patterns, counts, or attribute values, plus notification channels. These rules fire automatically when signal conditions are met. The only documented action, though, is sending notifications, not broader automated actions. missing for 10: documented action types beyond notifications (e.g., webhooks or remediation/runbook triggers), detailed rule-engine docs covering conditions and evaluation, independent or hands-on corroboration of alert automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Set up alerts on log patterns, counts, or attribute values.
Monitor signals and receive timely notifications
manage dashboards, alert rules, saved views, and notification channels.
